name: Carnosine
summary: Carnosine (beta-alanine + histidine dipeptide) has diabetes RCTs on glucose and advanced glycation end-products. Beta-alanine's end product may matter more for diabetes than for gym performance.
description: Canonical Carnosine research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site's review gates.

research_metadata.evidence_notes: Diabetes RCTs on glucose and AGEs (PMIDs flagged verify-before-publishing). Distinct from zinc carnosine.
